hypothesis: A rank-40 binary-right residual factor shared by the complete layer-0 gate and up projections will materially outperform the same-rate learned gain-hash correction while retaining a complete component rate below 1.55 bits per weight

candidate.representation: W approximately equals T plus A C; T is exact-64-of-128 ternary with row-normalized four-bit scale indices, A is signed per-row INT4, and each row of shared C is an FP16 scale times 5120 binary signs
candidate.storage_contract: all ternary codes, four-bit group-scale indices, row anchors, ratio codebooks, INT4 left factors, FP16 left scales, shared binary right signs, FP16 right scales, and headers counted

control.representation: same frozen exported ternary residual plus rank-40 learned one-sparse bucket sign and three-bit gain route with signed per-row INT4 coefficients

decision_policy: a pass advances directly to activation-weighted fitting and the complete gate-up-down layer, not another sampled weight-space route screen
a rejection is terminal for this exact rank-40 binary-right family and does not authorize seed or threshold tuning
the factor artifact is a research checkpoint and is excluded from the canonical storage claim until a codec roundtrip exists
CUTE MMLU-type MATH WikiText code and paired CPU throughput remain mandatory before any model or breakthrough claim
prior art includes LQ-LoRA, ASVD, SVDQuant, and ExTernD; this experiment cannot establish novelty
claim_boundary: full real gate-up weight-space screen only; not a complete MLP layer, activation, model capability, runtime, whole-model rate, novelty, or breakthrough result
